scope: Authoritative product workflow configuration; not execution evidence.
ancestor_condition: Multi-commit pull requests only, as upstream.
pocx_case_policy: Reviewed inherited adaptations, legitimate PoCX-only cases and justified PoW exclusions within corresponding inherited configurations; no extra platform/configuration combinations.
windows_artifact_policy: Each product produces and consumes its own matching frozen-revision artifact per CRT, without an other-product test prerequisite; native Windows execution remains required.
status_policy: Failures, skips, inactive cases, cancellations, unverified cases and reviewed exclusions remain distinct from passes.
pending_repairs: Verify exact inherited functional selections and original optional prerequisite boundaries on hosted platforms.
Verify current PoCX fuzz configurations on native macOS and Windows and in hosted Linux CI.
Verify current OFF fuzz configurations on their target platforms at the matching revision.
execution_status: Changed configuration requires matching-revision hosted verification; infrastructure checks are not proof of a green pipeline.
functional_selection: Inherited BASE/EXTENDED, explicit exclusions and effective per-case transports. Format11 proofs bind selection and RPC coverage; PoCX-only cases remain within corresponding configurations.
optional_prerequisites: Preserve original packages and privileges; BCC required only in ASan. Source-guarded missing optional modules remain upstream-optional-skip, never pass.
